_README: Judgment inputs for the Risk tab. scripts/gen_risk_json.py reads this, joins it to
the live IBKR book (data/ibkr_flex.json) and live prices, and writes prototypes/risk.json.
EVERYTHING IN THIS FILE IS A HUMAN DECISION. Nothing here is refreshed by the pipeline.
The generator recomputes only what is unambiguously price-driven: marks, stop distances,
vol, ATR, touch probabilities, VaR, correlation, gross, stop_total and the budget meters.
Stops live HERE, not in the Flex feed: an Activity Flex Query has 47 sections and none
of them report working orders, so a GTC stop cannot be read back from IBKR unattended.
Confirm them in TWS and update stop_confirmed_on when you do.
scenarios / slippage / gap are authored at the prices in price_basis. They do NOT
auto-update - the betas behind rows other than the gas shock are not documented, and
the generator will not invent them. When live prices drift past drift_tolerance the
output carries judgment_stale=true and the tab says so. Re-derive them and bump
reviewed_on.
GOOGL (added 19 Sep 2026) - derivations, so these are reproducible:
beta to SPX 1.5353 - OLS on simple daily returns, trailing 60 bars to 18 Sep 2026,
corr 0.477. The 60-bar window is the one the generator already uses for vol. Wider
windows give 252d 1.3348 and full-3y 1.1787, so 1.5353 is the conservative end.
Broad market -3%: GOOGL term = 70,400 * 1.5353 * 0.03 = 3,242.55, added on top of the
unchanged 369 energy term. The implied -4.61% move puts GOOGL at 335.79, through the
340 stop, so clean fills takes the 12.00 stop distance (2,400) and the gap case takes
the full move.
Mega-cap tech -10%: theme shock at beta 1.0 to its own theme, 70,400 * 0.10 = 7,040.
Rates +50bp: NO GOOGL term added. Measured slope -0.0083%/bp (n=746) at corr -0.023,
i.e. no detectable rate sensitivity in a 3-year sample. That is a sample finding, not a
claim that long-duration equity is rate-insensitive - revisit after a real rate shock.
gap and slippage are UNCHANGED: both model a nat-gas gap event, which GOOGL does not
participate in. The slippage ladder is UNG-only by construction (index.html hardcodes
the UNG loss column), so a GOOGL stop-slippage ladder needs a UI change, not just data.
The betas behind Energy equities -12% and Crude -10% remain UNDETERMINED - two unknown
betas and one equation each, so they cannot be recovered and were not touched.

limits.basis: NAV fixed at the $300,000 notional mandate. Never measured against account equity.

TLT.reason: Excluded by the account owner as outside this book. Still held in the same margin account, so account-level margin cannot be ring-fenced to these two positions.

gap.basis: UNG full -20% with no stop protection

not_configured: Single-commodity concentration (UNG is {UNG_PCT} of the book)
Gross exposure backstop for gap risk

news.title: Natural gas at a three-week low on a bearish storage build
news.body: Gas fell to about $2.80/MMBtu. The EIA reported a 40 Bcf injection for the week to 4 Sep against roughly 31 Bcf expected, lifting stocks to 3.254 Tcf - some 4.8% above the five-year average. Lower-48 output averages 112.9 Bcf/d in September.
news.src: EIA Short-Term Energy Outlook, Trading Economics, NGI - Sep 2026

notes: NAV is $300,000 throughout - the notional mandate assigned by the firm. Never measured against account equity, by instruction. 1% = $3,000.
Limits are provisional, set 15 Sep 2026: 2% maximum loss per theme, 6% across the portfolio. Not a written company risk policy.
Themes are assigned, not fed. IBKR returns no sector tags; every theme in this file is a stated assumption.

Stop distances are shown as probability of being touched over a holding period, not in daily sigma - these are GTC orders with no expiry. The probability is the reflection-principle first-passage estimate 2*Phi(-ln(S/B)/(sigma*sqrt(T))) on realised daily vol, zero drift.

Stops are confirmed by the account owner, not read from the API: an IBKR Activity Flex Query cannot report working orders. Still unconfirmed: whether they are enabled outside regular trading hours - most gaps occur overnight, which is exactly when a stop is least likely to help.
Parametric VaR understates the tail: the historical 5th percentile has run above the parametric figure, and the worst day in the window was roughly 1.5x the 99% VaR.
Correlation between the two legs is not a usable parameter - the standard error is wide and the rolling 20-day figure has swung through zero in both directions.
Scenario betas are assumed: UNG ~1.0 to front-month gas. The XOP terms were removed with the position on 23 Sep 2026.
Scenario, slippage and gap figures are authored at the prices in price_basis and do not move with the market. The tab flags them when live prices drift past tolerance.

Independently reviewed. The first issue was blocked and reissued: sigma framing replaced with touch probabilities, the -20% gas scenario corrected, and claims of a risk-free position and of diversification withdrawn.

MSFT, CRM, GNRC, SMCI and SNOW were added on 23 Sep 2026. Their stops are the GTC working orders read from the IBKR account's live order endpoint, not the Flex query - the same endpoint returns GOOGL 340.00 and UNG 9.35, which match the stops already confirmed in this file. Their themes are assigned assumptions, not fed.

Scenarios, slippage and the gap figure cover UNG and GOOGL only. The five positions added on 23 Sep 2026 carry no authored scenario terms, so every scenario row understates the current book. XOP was stopped out on 22 Sep 2026 and its scenario, news and gap terms were removed.
